units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 6:5">B. Bath. VI, 5</cite> <he>זה עושה לו פ׳ וכ׳</he> this one (the owner of the well) has the right to put on a lock, and so that one (the owner of the house) has.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 13:6">Kel. XIII, 6</cite>, v. <cite ref="H01417"><he>חָף</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="Q00339"><he>פּוֹתְחוֹת</he></cite>.
